verdict.rationale: Stripe's webhook docs show a first-party refresh mechanism: separate events fire after balance, ownership and transaction refreshes complete, which implies asynchronous refresh operations per data type. However, no cited doc shows an API call that triggers a refresh on demand, and a community comment mentions a limit of 'only daily pulls,' which leaves the freshness ceiling unclear. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an on-demand refresh API endpoint, documented refresh semantics (rate limits, frequency caps, status lifecycle), hands-on corroboration that on-demand refresh works.
